title: Identification of novel immunotherapy targets in myeloma
description: RNA sequencing (RNA-Seq) was performed on 94 multiple myeloma (MM) patient samples. We used genomic subgroup and high-risk markers to identify therapeutic targets, including TNFRSF17, GPRC5D, ITGA4, and LAX1, with low predicted toxicity and high specificity to MM and genomic subgroups such as those with TP53 alterations.
